Messages.Author: Johannes Walch
Messages.Body:
I have a Dual Form on a vampire, effectively making it two vampires with
lower capacity. I play Social Ladder on both of them. What happens in
the influence phase?

a) Both Social Ladders trigger at the same time, moving the blood from
both vampires.

b) One Social Ladder triggers moving the blood from one vampire and
triggering the effect of Social Ladder and burning the second. I can
choose which one.

--
johannes walch

Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:



I would say 'b', because VTES has no simultaneous effects.
